description: The same source IP behind a GuardDuty-detected EC2 backdoor/C2 connection also directly calls Secrets Manager -- cross-source: GuardDuty finding + CloudTrail activity, correlated by network.source_ip (infrastructure reuse, not identity).
playbook: GuardDuty flagged this IP as backdoor/C2 infrastructure; the same IP then called GetSecretValue directly. This is suggestive infrastructure reuse, not a confirmed single-identity compromise (no automated response is wired -- the correlation alert's primary_signal may be the GuardDuty finding, which carries no resolvable IAM identity for the EC2 backdoor finding family). Investigate manually: identify which credentials made the Secrets Manager call and whether they're related to the flagged instance.
